requirements.text: The ESA sample(s) of the rear lamp shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the submitted lamp samples for a clearly legible, indelible trade name/mark and type designation; pass if both are present and survive rub testing.

requirements.text: The representative ESA system(s) shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 6. and, if applicable, paragraph 7. of this Regulation for type approval to be granted.
requirements.test_case: Review the test report for the representative lamp ESA; pass if all paragraph 6 requirements are met.

requirements.text: The electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) conforming to a type approved under this Regulation shall have an approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. affixed to it, except that no marking is required for electrical/electronic systems built into vehicles which are approved as units.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the production lamp for the R10 approval mark per paragraph 5.3; pass if present (or the lamp is only covered by a vehicle-unit approval).

requirements.text: The approval mark of the ESA shall comprise a circle containing the letter "E", followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval mark on the lamp; pass if it shows a circle with 'E' and the approving country number.

requirements.text: The approval mark of the ESA shall comprise the number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle specified in paragraph 5.3.1.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval mark on the lamp; pass if '10R-' followed by the approval number appears to the right of the E-circle.

requirements.text: The ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Review the design and EMC test results of the lamp; pass if the lamp meets the R10 emission and immunity requirements in normal use.

requirements.text: The ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions, for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report covers radiated and conducted emissions and radiated and conducted immunity tests on the lamp; pass if all four are performed and passed.

requirements.text: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.
requirements.test_case: Perform broadband radiated emission measurement per Annex 7 on the lamp ESA; pass if the test is completed per the method.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz.
requirements.test_case: Measure broadband emissions per Annex 7 from 30 to 75 MHz; pass if all values are below the logarithmically decreasing 62-52 dBµV/m limit.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband limits shall be 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure broadband emissions per Annex 7 from 75 to 400 MHz; pass if all values are below the 52-63 dBµV/m limit line of Appendix 6.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the ESA broadband limit remains constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.test_case: Measure broadband emissions per Annex 7 from 400 to 1,000 MHz; pass if all values are below 63 dBµV/m.

requirements.text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured broadband values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.test_case: Compare Annex 7 broadband measurement results with the 6.5.2.1 limits; pass if all values are below the limits.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the ESA narrowband limits shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz.
requirements.test_case: Measure narrowband emissions per Annex 8 from 30 to 75 MHz; pass if all values are below the 52-42 dBµV/m limit line.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the ESA narrowband limits shall be 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 7.
requirements.test_case: Measure narrowband emissions per Annex 8 from 75 to 400 MHz; pass if all values are below the 42-53 dBµV/m limit line of Appendix 7.

requirements.text: The emission of transient conducted disturbances of the ESA representative of its type on 12/24 V supply lines shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10 for the levels given in Table 1.
requirements.test_case: Perform ISO 7637-2 transient emission test per Annex 10 on the lamp supply lines, unless exempted per 6.10.5.

requirements.text: The maximum allowed positive pulse amplitude of transient conducted emissions generated by the ESA shall be +75 V for vehicles with 12 V systems and +150 V for vehicles with 24 V systems, as given in Table 1.
requirements.test_case: Record transient emissions per ISO 7637-2; pass if positive pulse amplitudes do not exceed +75 V (12 V) or +150 V (24 V).

requirements.text: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) chosen from those described in Annex 9.
requirements.test_case: Perform radiated immunity test using a method chosen from Annex 9 on the lamp, unless exempted per 6.10.3.

requirements.text: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) as described in Annex 9 with the test severity in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band given in Table 2a and the minimum test level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band given in Table 2b.
requirements.test_case: Verify test report shows Annex 9 radiated immunity test at Table 2a levels over >90% of band and Table 2b minimum levels over whole band.

requirements.text: For the ALSE method, the ESA shall be tested at 30 V/m in over 90 per cent and a minimum of 25 V/m over the whole of the 80 to 2,000 MHz range, and at 10 V/m in over 90 per cent and a minimum of 8 V/m over the whole of the 2,000 to 6,000 MHz range (Tables 2a and 2b).
requirements.test_case: Check ALSE test levels: 30/25 V/m for 80-2,000 MHz and 10/8 V/m for 2,000-6,000 MHz with no degradation.

requirements.text: For the stripline method, the ESA shall be tested in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range at 60 V/m in over 90 per cent of the band (Table 2a) and a minimum of 50 V/m over the whole band (Table 2b).
requirements.test_case: Check stripline test levels: 60 V/m over >90% and ≥50 V/m over 20-400 MHz with no degradation.

requirements.text: For the reverberation chamber method, the ESA shall be tested at 21 V/m in over 90 per cent and a minimum of 18 V/m over the whole of the LUF to 2,000 MHz range, and at 7 V/m in over 90 per cent and a minimum of 6 V/m over the whole of the 2,000 to 6,000 MHz range (Tables 2a and 2b).
requirements.test_case: Check reverberation chamber levels: 21/18 V/m for LUF-2,000 MHz and 7/6 V/m for 2,000-6,000 MHz with no degradation.

requirements.text: Where the ESA does not include an electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz, it shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.3.2. or 6.6.2. and with Annexes 5 and 8.
requirements.test_case: Review circuit design/BOM for oscillators >9 kHz; if none, narrowband test may be waived.

requirements.text: While tests are performed in accordance with Annex 9, the ESA representative of its type shall be considered as complying with immunity requirements if there is no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions".
requirements.test_case: Monitor lamp functions (e.g. stop lamp) during Annex 9 tests; pass if no degradation of immunity related functions.

requirements.text: The immunity of ESA representative of this type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 16750-2 for starting profile and ISO 7637-2 for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b, as described in Annex 10, with the test levels given in Tables 3a and 3b.
requirements.test_case: Perform conducted transient immunity tests per Annex 10 with Table 3a/3b levels; pass if required classes are met.

requirements.text: The starting profile shall be tested according to the functional status classification as defined in ISO 16750-1.
requirements.test_case: Verify starting profile test results are classified per ISO 16750-1.

requirements.text: The Functional Performance Status Classification (FPSC) as in ISO 7637-1 shall be applied for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b.
requirements.test_case: Verify pulse test results are classified using ISO 7637-1 FPSC.

requirements.text: For pulse 1, the ESA shall meet immunity test level -75 V (12V system) or -450 V (24V system) for 500 pulses with FPSC III for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
requirements.test_case: Apply pulse 1 at -75 V/-450 V, 500 pulses; pass if FPSC III achieved.

requirements.text: For pulse 3a, the ESA shall meet immunity test level -112 V (12V system) or -150 V (24V system) for 1 h with FPSC I for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
requirements.test_case: Apply pulse 3a at -112 V/-150 V for 1 h; pass if FPSC I / III achieved.

requirements.text: For the 12 V system starting profile (ISO 16750-2, test level II, 10 pulses), an ESA that shall be operational during engine start phases shall reach functional status class B if it performs immunity-related functions and class D if it does not, and any other ESA shall reach class C, as given in Table 3a; the starting profile applies only to ESAs that may be installed in vehicles with an internal combustion engine started by a 12 V / 24 V starter motor.
requirements.test_case: Apply 12 V starting profile level II, 10 pulses; pass if lamp reaches required class B/C/D.

requirements.text: ESAs with no immunity related functions need not be tested for immunity to radiated disturbances and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.8. and with Annex 9 to this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Assess whether lamp functions are immunity related per Annex 9; if none, radiated immunity test may be waived.

requirements.text: ESAs that are not switched, contain no switches or do not include inductive load need not be tested for transient conducted emission and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.7.
requirements.test_case: Review lamp circuit for switches/inductive loads; if none, transient emission test may be waived.

requirements.text: In the frequency range 30-75 MHz, the broadband electromagnetic radiation emitted by the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) shall not exceed the reference limit E = 62 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m, measured with a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1.).
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA broadband radiated emissions per Annex 7 from 30-75 MHz with 120 kHz bandwidth; pass if all readings are at or below 62 - 25.13 log(F/30) dBµV/m.

requirements.text: In the frequency range 75-400 MHz, the broadband electromagnetic radiation emitted by the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) shall not exceed the reference limit E = 52 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m, measured with a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1.).
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA broadband radiated emissions from 75-400 MHz with 120 kHz bandwidth; pass if all readings are at or below 52 + 15.13 log(F/75) dBµV/m.

requirements.text: In the frequency range 30-75 MHz, the narrowband electromagnetic radiation emitted by the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) shall not exceed the reference limit E = 52 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m, measured with a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraph 6.6.2.1.).
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA narrowband radiated emissions per Annex 8 from 30-75 MHz with 120 kHz bandwidth; pass if all readings are at or below 52 - 25.13 log(F/30) dBµV/m.

requirements.text: If not otherwise stated in Annex 7, the measurement of broadband electromagnetic emissions from the ESA shall be performed according to CISPR 25.
requirements.test_case: Review the test report to confirm that radiated broadband emissions were measured per CISPR 25 as referenced in Annex 7.

requirements.text: During the radiated broadband emission test, the ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
requirements.test_case: Check the test set-up record that the lamp functions (position, stop, reversing) were energised in normal operation at maximum load during measurement.

requirements.text: For ESA other than involved in "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid", the radiated broadband emission test shall be performed according to the ALSE method described in Clause 6.4 of CISPR 25.
requirements.test_case: Verify in the test report that the ALSE method of CISPR 25 Clause 6.4 (or an OATS per CISPR 16-1-4 as alternative) was used.

requirements.text: The radiated broadband emission limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
requirements.test_case: Verify the emission scan covers 30 to 1,000 MHz and all readings are below the applicable limits.

requirements.text: If not otherwise stated in Annex 8, the narrowband electromagnetic emissions test of the ESA shall be performed according to CISPR 25.
requirements.test_case: Review test report to confirm the narrowband emission test was carried out to CISPR 25 unless Annex 8 states otherwise.

requirements.text: The narrowband emissions test of the ESA shall be performed according to the ALSE method described in paragraph 6.4. of CISPR 25.
requirements.test_case: Confirm test setup in report follows CISPR 25 clause 6.4 ALSE arrangement (or an OATS compliant with CISPR 16-1-4 as alternative).

requirements.text: The ESA may comply with the requirements of any combination of the following test methods at the manufacturer's discretion, provided that these result in the full frequency range specified in paragraph 3.1. of this Annex being covered: (a) Absorber chamber test according to ISO 11452-2; (b) TEM cell testing according to ISO 11452-3; (c) Bulk current injection testing according to ISO 11452-4; (d) Stripline testing according to ISO 11452-5; (e) Reverberation chamber test according to ISO 11452-11.
requirements.test_case: Review the immunity test plan and reports to confirm that the selected ISO 11452 methods together cover the full 20 to 6,000 MHz range.

requirements.text: The frequency range and general test conditions for the immunity tests of the ESA to electromagnetic radiation shall be based on ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report to confirm that the frequency range and general test conditions reference ISO 11452-1.

requirements.text: The test conditions for the ESA during immunity tests to electromagnetic radiation shall be according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Audit the test report to confirm that the test conditions (temperature, supply voltage, etc.) are set per ISO 11452-1.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be switched on and shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.
requirements.test_case: Verify that the lamp functions (position, stop, reversing) are energised and operating normally during the immunity exposure.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be arranged as defined in this Annex unless individual test methods dictate otherwise.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the test set-up photos or drawings against the Annex 9 arrangement requirements.

requirements.text: Immunity measurements of the ESA shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Check that the test report covers 20 to 6,000 MHz with ISO 11452-1 frequency steps.

requirements.text: Unless otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the test signal modulation shall be AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range.
requirements.test_case: Verify in the test report that AM 1 kHz, 80 % depth modulation was used from 20 to 400 MHz.

requirements.text: Unless otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the test signal modulation shall be PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range.
requirements.test_case: Verify in the test report that PM2 modulation (Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs) was used from 2,700 to 3,100 MHz.

requirements.text: Unless otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the test signal modulation shall be PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges.
requirements.test_case: Verify in the test report that PM3 modulation (Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs) was used from 380 to 2,700 MHz and from 3,100 to 6,000 MHz.

requirements.text: The frequency step size and dwell time shall be chosen according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Check that the step size and dwell time in the report conform to ISO 11452-1.

requirements.text: If an ESA fails the tests defined in this Annex, it shall be verified as having failed under the relevant test conditions and not as a result of the generation of uncontrolled fields.
requirements.test_case: For any failure, confirm through field monitoring that the failure occurred under controlled test field conditions.

requirements.text: When the absorber chamber test is used, the "substitution method" shall be used to establish the test field conditions according to ISO 11452-2.
requirements.test_case: Verify that the absorber chamber report states field calibration by the substitution method per ISO 11452-2.

requirements.text: When the absorber chamber test is used, the test shall be performed with vertical polarization.
requirements.test_case: Confirm in the report that vertical antenna polarization was used.

requirements.text: When TEM cell testing is used, the test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-3.
requirements.test_case: Check that the TEM cell test report references and follows ISO 11452-3.

requirements.text: When bulk current injection testing is used, the test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-4 on a test bench, either with the BCI substitution method and the injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA, or with the BCI closed loop method and the injection probe positioned at 900 mm distance to the ESA.
requirements.test_case: Verify the BCI report for an ISO 11452-4 bench set-up with the probe at 150 mm (substitution method) or 900 mm (closed loop method).

requirements.text: When the reverberation chamber test is used, the test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-11.
requirements.test_case: Check that the reverberation chamber test report follows ISO 11452-11.

requirements.text: The test method shall ensure the immunity of the ESA (rear combination lamp) to conducted transients on the vehicle power supply.
requirements.test_case: Perform conducted transient immunity tests per Annex 10 and confirm the lamp functions remain within the required functional status.

requirements.text: The test method shall limit conducted transients from the ESA (rear combination lamp) to the vehicle power supply.
requirements.test_case: Measure conducted transient emissions per Annex 10 and confirm they are within the regulation limits.

requirements.text: For immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, the test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to ISO 7637-2 shall be applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of the ESA which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.test_case: Apply ISO 7637-2 pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b to all supply and operationally connected lines and verify the required FPSC is achieved.

requirements.text: For immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, the starting profile according to ISO 16750-2 shall be applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of the ESA which may be operationally connected to supply lines, except that ESAs exclusively reserved for mounting on electric vehicles (vehicles without 12V/24V starter motor) are not subject to starting profile.
requirements.test_case: Apply the ISO 16750-2 starting profile to the supply and operationally connected lines and verify the required functional status class is achieved.

requirements.text: The emission of transient conducted disturbances generated by the ESA on 12/24 V supply lines shall be measured according to ISO 7637-2 on supply lines as well as on other connections of the ESA which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.test_case: Measure transient conducted emissions per ISO 7637-2 on supply and operationally connected lines and compare against the regulation limits.

requirements.text: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp mounting and verify after vibration/normal use that photometric and installation characteristics remain within prescribed limits.

requirements.text: It shall not be possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the mounting and fixings to confirm the lamp cannot be shifted out of its intended orientation without deliberate action.

requirements.text: For all light-signalling devices, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road, with a tolerance of ±3°.
requirements.test_case: Measure the angle between the lamp reference axis and the road bearing plane on the vehicle; pass if within ±3°.

requirements.text: For the rear light-signalling devices (other than side retro-reflectors and side-marker lamps), the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, with a tolerance of ±3°.
requirements.test_case: Measure the angle between the lamp reference axis and the vehicle median longitudinal plane; pass if within ±3°.

requirements.text: Any specific instructions as regards fitting of the light-signalling devices laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with.
requirements.test_case: Compare the installed lamp against the manufacturer's fitting instructions; pass if all instructions are met.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the lamps shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface, in the condition defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2.
requirements.test_case: Measure lamp height and orientation with the unladen vehicle on a flat horizontal surface and confirm compliance.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane (based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface).
requirements.test_case: Measure the lateral positions of the left and right lamps relative to the median longitudinal plane; pass if symmetrical.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane; this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Compare the external geometry of the left and right hand lamps; pass if mirror-symmetrical about the median plane.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity of each function on left and right lamps; pass if both meet the same colour requirements.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics, except for a matched pair of a function.
requirements.test_case: Compare photometric measurements of left and right lamps; pass if substantially identical.

requirements.text: In case of lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo can be fitted on the rear of the vehicle, and all logos that are not vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logos are prohibited.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the rear lamps for logos; pass if at most one per side or one central and only vehicle/body manufacturer logos.

requirements.text: Where lamps are grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another, all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, shall be fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Verify each function in the combination lamp individually against its colour, position, orientation, visibility and electrical connection requirements.

requirements.text: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
requirements.test_case: Measure photometry and colour of each function with all other functions of the lamp switched off; pass if within limits.

requirements.text: When a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with it, the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the rear position lamps are switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Switch on the rear position lamp together with the reciprocally incorporated function and measure colour; pass if the other function's colour requirements are met.

requirements.text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), the apparent surface of which is composed of two or more distinct parts, shall be installed in such a way that either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis occupies not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing that projection, or the minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts does not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis; this does not apply to a single retro-reflector.
requirements.test_case: Measure projected apparent surface parts; pass if area ratio ≥ 60 % of circumscribing quadrilateral or gap between parts ≤ 75 mm.

requirements.text: Red light emitted by the rear position lamp, the stop lamp and the rear retro-reflector fitted on the rear of the vehicle shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Check on the vehicle that no red light from the rear lamp is visible from the front.

requirements.text: The maximum height above the ground of the lamps shall be measured from the highest point and the minimum height from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.
requirements.test_case: Measure the highest and lowest points of each function's apparent surface above ground on the vehicle and compare with height limits.

requirements.text: For the purposes of reducing the geometric visibility angles, the position of a lamp with regard to height above the ground shall be measured from the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Where reduced vertical visibility angles are used, measure the lamp height from the H plane and confirm the reduction condition is met.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of the rear position, stop and reversing lamps shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Operate each function and verify intensity, colour and apparent surface remain constant while switched ON.

requirements.text: Where the photometric characteristics of the lamp vary in relation to the ambient light, as a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF, or when the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function, any variation in the photometric characteristics shall be in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.test_case: Measure photometry in each varying state and confirm all values stay within the device approval limits.

requirements.text: For the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4).
requirements.test_case: Observe from Zone 1 at 25 m in front of the vehicle per Annex 4; no red apparent surface shall be directly visible.

requirements.text: In case of doubt, the requirement on visibility of red light towards the front shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.
requirements.test_case: Measure luminous intensity of red light emitted forward; pass if ≤ 0.25 cd per lamp.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously, except while the conditions listed in paragraph 5.11.1. exist (parking lamps, side-marker lamps flashing with direction indicators, daytime running lamps switched ON, front position lamps substituted under paragraph 5.12.1.).
requirements.test_case: Operate the lighting switch on the vehicle and verify the rear position lamps switch ON/OFF together with front position and registration plate lamps.

requirements.text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.test_case: Switch the function and verify all light sources of the interdependent system light and extinguish simultaneously.

requirements.text: The concealment of the rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors shall be prohibited.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation to confirm the rear lamp functions are not concealable.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity of the reversing lamp and confirm it is within the white limits.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity of the stop lamp and confirm it is within the red limits.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the rear position lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity of the rear position lamp and confirm it is within the red limits.

requirements.text: The colour of the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure colour of the retro-reflected light and confirm it is red.

requirements.text: The number of rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Count the installed lamps per function and compare with paragraph 6 individual specifications.

requirements.text: The lamp may be installed on movable components only provided that the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Verify compliance with paragraphs 5.18 to 5.20 for any lamp mounted on a movable component.

requirements.text: Rear position lamps and rear retro-reflectors may be installed on movable components only if at all fixed positions of the movable components the lamps on the movable components meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps.
requirements.test_case: Check position, visibility angles, colour and photometry at each fixed position of the movable component.

requirements.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear position lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".
requirements.test_case: With movable components in each fixed open position, measure the obscured portion of the apparent surface; pass if ≤ 50 %.

requirements.text: With the exception of retro-reflectors, a lamp even bearing an approval mark is deemed not to be present when it cannot be made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse.
requirements.test_case: Check on the vehicle that the rear position, stop and reversing lamps operate once light source and/or fuse are installed, without further wiring.

requirements.text: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity, except obstacles already presented when the lamp was type-approved.
requirements.test_case: Check on the vehicle that no part of the vehicle obstructs light from the apparent surface within the prescribed geometric visibility angles.

requirements.text: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
requirements.test_case: Where vehicle parts hide part of the apparent surface, measure photometry of the unobstructed part and confirm it meets device approval values.

requirements.text: All lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Verify the rear position, stop, reversing lamps and retro-reflector carry valid R148/R150 type approvals and markings.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be present on motor vehicles (mandatory).
requirements.test_case: Inspect the M1 vehicle installation and confirm at least one reversing lamp is fitted.

requirements.text: On motor vehicles of category M1, one reversing lamp device is mandatory and a second device is optional.
requirements.test_case: Count the reversing lamps installed on the M1 vehicle; pass if one or two are fitted.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check the reversing lamp carries a valid R23 or R148 approval mark and approval certificate.

requirements.text: In height, the reversing lamp shall be positioned not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.
requirements.test_case: Measure the apparent surface height on the unladen vehicle; pass if between 250 mm and 1,200 mm.

requirements.text: In length, the reversing lamp shall be positioned at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation and confirm the reversing lamp is located at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: For reversing lamp devices installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility defined by angle α as specified in paragraph 2.10.7. shall be α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: Verify on the vehicle that the apparent surface is visible over 15° upwards and 5° downwards.

requirements.text: For reversing lamp devices installed at the rear of the vehicle, if there is only one device, the geometric visibility defined by angle β as specified in paragraph 2.10.7. shall be β = 45° to right and to left.
requirements.test_case: Verify visibility of the apparent surface over 45° to the right and left of the single device.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation and confirm the reference axis of the reversing lamp points rearwards.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the reversing lamp shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.test_case: Functional test: lamp lights only with reverse gear engaged and propulsion system operable.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall not switch ON or remain ON if either the reverse gear is not engaged or the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is not in a position in which operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.test_case: Disengage reverse gear or switch off propulsion system and confirm the lamp switches OFF and cannot be switched ON.

requirements.text: For the reversing lamp, a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check the component approval; if failure indication is required, simulate failure and confirm the tell-tale activates.

requirements.text: Stop lamp devices of S1 or S2 categories shall be mandatory on all categories of vehicles (including M1).
requirements.test_case: Inspect the M1 vehicle installation and confirm that S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices are fitted.

requirements.text: Two S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices and one S3 or S4 category device shall be installed on all categories of vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Count the stop lamps on the vehicle and confirm two S1/S2 devices (left and right rear combination lamps) and one S3/S4 device.

requirements.text: The stop lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval mark and certificate of the stop lamp for an R7 (02 series or later) or R148 (00 series or later) approval.

requirements.text: For M1 category vehicles, for S1 or S2 categories stop lamps, that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure on the vehicle the lateral distance from the outermost point of the stop lamp apparent surface to the vehicle outer edge; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

requirements.text: For S1 or S2 categories stop lamps, the height above the ground shall be not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.test_case: Measure the stop lamp apparent surface height above ground per paragraph 5.8.1; pass if between 350 mm and 1,500 mm (or 2,100 mm where justified).

requirements.text: In length, S1 or S2 categories stop lamps shall be positioned at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle installation; pass if the stop lamps are located at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility horizontal angle for S1 or S2 categories stop lamps shall be 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Verify on the installed lamp that the apparent surface is visible over 45° left and right; pass if unobstructed over the full angle.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility vertical angle for S1 or S2 categories stop lamps shall be 15° above and below the horizontal.
requirements.test_case: Verify on the installed lamp visibility of the apparent surface over 15° up and down; pass if unobstructed.

requirements.text: For stop lamps of categories S1 and S2 mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward horizontal angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Measure mounting height; if below 750 mm verify inward visibility of at least 20° under the H plane.

requirements.text: Where an S1 or S2 category stop lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward vertical angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Measure mounting height; if below 750 mm verify downward visibility of at least 5°.

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 category stop lamps shall be oriented towards the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect installation; pass if the stop lamp reference axis points rearwards.

requirements.text: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
requirements.test_case: Apply the braking signal on the vehicle; pass if all stop lamps switch ON simultaneously.

requirements.text: Rear position lamps of R or R1 or R2 categories shall be mandatory.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle; pass if rear position lamps of category R, R1 or R2 are fitted.

requirements.text: In width, that point on the apparent surface of the rear position lamp in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lateral distance from the outermost point of the rear position lamp apparent surface to the vehicle outer edge; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

requirements.text: In height, the rear position lamps shall be above the ground, not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.test_case: Measure the rear position lamp apparent surface height per paragraph 5.8.1; pass if between 350 mm and 1,500 mm (or 2,100 mm where justified).

requirements.text: The geometric visibility horizontal angle for the rear position lamps shall be 45° inwards and 80° outwards.
requirements.test_case: Verify on the installed lamp visibility of the apparent surface over 45° inwards and 80° outwards; pass if unobstructed.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility vertical angle for the rear position lamps shall be 15° above and below the horizontal.
requirements.test_case: Verify on the installed lamp visibility over 15° up and down; pass if unobstructed.

requirements.text: Where a rear position lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward horizontal angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Measure mounting height; if below 750 mm verify inward visibility of at least 20° under the H plane.

requirements.text: To be considered visible, the rear position lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres, excluding the illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light.
requirements.test_case: Measure unobstructed apparent surface (excluding non-transmitting retro-reflector area) in the visibility directions; pass if ≥ 12.5 cm².

requirements.text: The rear position lamps shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Inspect installation; pass if the rear position lamp reference axis points rearwards.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the rear position lamps shall be in accordance with paragraph 5.11.
requirements.test_case: Check the wiring and switching of the rear position lamps against paragraph 5.11; pass if compliant.

requirements.text: A closed-circuit tell-tale for the rear position lamps is mandatory.
requirements.test_case: Switch on the rear position lamps on the vehicle and verify that a closed-circuit tell-tale illuminates.

requirements.text: The closed-circuit tell-tale of the rear position lamps shall be combined with that of the front position lamps; this requirement does not apply when daytime running lamps are switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Check on the vehicle that the same tell-tale indicates operation of both the front and rear position lamps.

requirements.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the rear position lamps is mandatory if required by the component Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Simulate a failure of the rear position lamp and verify that the failure tell-tale is activated where required by the component Regulation.

requirements.text: In all cases, the distance between the rear fog-lamp and each stop-lamp shall be greater than 100 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure on the vehicle the distance between the rear fog lamp and each stop lamp of the rear lamp; pass if greater than 100 mm.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, is mandatory on motor vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Verify that the M1 vehicle is fitted with non-triangular rear retro-reflectors.

requirements.text: The number of rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall be two, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
requirements.test_case: Check that two rear retro-reflectors are fitted and carry a Class IA or IB approval mark under UN R3 (02 series or later) or UN R150 (00 series or later).

requirements.text: In width, that point on the illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure on the vehicle the lateral distance from the outermost point of the retro-reflector illuminating surface to the vehicle's extreme outer edge; pass if not more than 400 mm.

requirements.text: In height, the rear retro-reflector shall be above the ground not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm (not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1,200 mm respectively).
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the retro-reflector above ground per paragraph 5.8.1.; pass if between 250 mm and 900 mm (1,200 mm if grouped with rear lamps, 1,500 mm where bodywork prevents).

requirements.text: In length, the rear retro-reflector shall be at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle and verify the retro-reflector is located at the rear.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the rear retro-reflector shall be a horizontal angle of 30° inwards and outwards.
requirements.test_case: Verify on the vehicle that the retro-reflector illuminating surface is visible over 30° inwards and outwards horizontally.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the rear retro-reflector shall be a vertical angle of 10° above and below horizontal; however, where the retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Verify on the vehicle that the retro-reflector is visible 10° above and 10° below the horizontal (5° below if mounted below 750 mm).

requirements.text: The orientation of the rear retro-reflector shall be rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation and verify the retro-reflector reference axis faces rearwards.

requirements.text: When daytime running lamps are switched ON, the rear position lamps shall be switched ON.
requirements.test_case: On the vehicle, activate the daytime running lamps and verify by inspection that the rear position lamps of the rear lamp are switched ON.

requirements.text: Where the emergency stop signal is provided by the stop lamps, the emergency stop signal shall be given by the simultaneous operation of all the stop lamps fitted as described in paragraph 6.23.7.
requirements.test_case: Trigger the emergency stop signal on the vehicle and check that all fitted stop lamps operate simultaneously.

requirements.text: All the lamps of the emergency stop signal shall flash in phase at a frequency of 4.0 ± 1.0 Hz.
requirements.test_case: Activate the emergency stop signal and measure the flash frequency and phase of all stop lamps; pass if they are in phase at 3.0-5.0 Hz.

requirements.text: The emergency stop signal shall operate independently of other lamps.
requirements.test_case: Activate the emergency stop signal with the other lamps in various states and check that its operation is unaffected.

requirements.text: The emergency stop signal shall be switched ON and OFF automatically.
requirements.test_case: Check that no manual control exists and that the signal is switched ON and OFF automatically.

requirements.text: The emergency stop signal shall be switched ON only when the vehicle speed is above 50 km/h and the braking system is providing the emergency braking logic signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
requirements.test_case: Perform braking tests above and below 50 km/h, with and without the emergency braking logic signal; pass if activation occurs only above 50 km/h with the signal present.

requirements.text: The emergency stop signal shall be automatically switched OFF if the emergency braking logic signal as defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H is no longer provided or if the hazard warning signal is activated.
requirements.test_case: Remove the emergency braking logic signal, or activate the hazard warning signal, and check that the emergency stop signal switches OFF automatically.

requirements.text: For the verification of the visibility of a red lamp to the front (paragraph 5.10.4.), the zone 1 explored by the eye of the observer shall be bounded in height by two horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m respectively above the ground.
requirements.test_case: Check on the vehicle that no red light from the rear position or stop lamp is directly visible from the front within the zone between 1 m and 2.2 m above ground.

requirements.text: For the verification of the visibility of a red lamp to the front (paragraph 5.10.4.), the zone 1 explored by the eye of the observer shall be bounded in width by a vertical plane which, forming to the front an angle of 15° outwards from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane, passes through the point or points of contact of vertical planes parallel to the vehicle's median longitudinal plane delimiting the vehicle's overall width.
requirements.test_case: Observe from the front zone bounded by the 15° outward planes through the vehicle width contact points and verify no red light from the rear lamp is directly visible.

requirements.text: When two or more lamps are part of the same unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, approval may be granted only if each of these lamps (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp, retro-reflector) satisfy the provisions set out in this Regulation or in another Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check that each function in the combination lamp holds or meets the requirements of its applicable Regulation (R148, R150).

requirements.text: Lamps not satisfying the provisions of any of those Regulations shall not be part of the unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps.
requirements.test_case: Review the function list of the unit and confirm that no non-compliant or unapproved function is integrated.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be identified by the symbol R1 (steady) or R2 (variable).
requirements.test_case: Check that the marking shows R1 or R2, matching the intensity control of the rear position lamp.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be identified by the symbol AR (the letters A and R may be mingled).
requirements.test_case: Check that the marking shows the symbol AR.

requirements.text: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraphs 3.3.3.2. to 3.3.3.6.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the drawing and sample to confirm that a marking space large enough for all required markings exists.

requirements.text: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the markings visually and apply a rub test; the markings shall remain legible.

requirements.text: With regard to the size of the approval marking, the value for "a" shall be at least 5 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure the dimension "a" of the approval marking; it shall be ≥ 5 mm.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking for a circled E followed by the country number.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the four to six-digit sequential number, being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking for a 4 to 6 digit sequential number matching the approval number.

requirements.text: The sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Check that the sequential number is located adjacent to the circled E mark.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the symbols identifying the light signalling lamps prescribed in paragraph 3.2.4.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking for the function symbols per Table 1.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the number of this Regulation followed by the letter 'R' and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking for "148R" followed by the series digits (e.g. 01).

requirements.text: On lamps which cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, the approval marking shall include a horizontal arrow showing in which position the lamp is to be mounted.
requirements.test_case: Inspect handed lamp samples for a horizontal arrow in the marking.

requirements.text: In the case of rear position lamps, the horizontal arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: With the lamp in its mounting position, check that the arrow points outboard.

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear the approval marking.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for the approval marking.

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for the applicant's trade name or mark.

requirements.text: Lamps, with the exception of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, shall bear a marking indicating the category or categories of light source(s) prescribed.
requirements.test_case: If the light sources are replaceable, inspect for the light source category marking.

requirements.text: Lamps with non-replaceable light sources shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Inspect for a rated voltage marking (e.g. 12V) or voltage range.

requirements.text: Lamps with an electronic light source control gear shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Inspect for a rated voltage or voltage range marking.

requirements.text: Lamps with a variable luminous intensity control shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Inspect for a rated voltage or voltage range marking.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the module for the applicant's trade name or mark.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the specific identification code of the module, comprising the starting letters "MD" followed by the approval mark without the circle (with additional symbols or characters if several non-identical modules are used); the approval mark shall be from the same applicant as that on the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the module for an MD code followed by the approval mark without the circle.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the module for a rated voltage marking.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) are used, the lamp shall bear the specific identification code of the module as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.3.5. (a), (ii).
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for the module identification code.

requirements.text: An electronic light source control gear or variable luminous intensity control being part of the lamp, but not included into the lamp body, shall be marked with its identification number and the name of the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the external control gear for an identification number and the manufacturer name.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp which is not designed to be separated from the transparent part of the lamp emitting the light.
requirements.test_case: Verify that the marking is on a part not designed to be separated from the light-emitting lens.

requirements.text: The approval marking, as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.
requirements.test_case: With the lamp fitted on the vehicle, check that the marking is visible, if necessary with the boot lid or a door opened.

requirements.text: If the outer lens of a device is designed to be separated from the main body, the approval marking shall be placed on both the detachable lens and the main body.
requirements.test_case: If the lens is detachable, inspect both the lens and the housing for the approval marking.

requirements.text: The approval marking and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.2., 3.3.3.3., 3.3.3.4., 3.3.3.5. (b) and 3.3.3.6. shall be affixed on the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp to confirm that all the listed markings are affixed on it.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark is affixed to the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, the approval marking shall be visible after their installation.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp installed on a representative vehicle mounting and confirm the single approval mark is visible.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark is affixed to the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, no part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Review the design/drawing and check that every light-transmitting part (e.g. outer lens) carries or is inseparable from the approval mark.

requirements.text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
requirements.test_case: Measure the approval mark components and compare with the minimum sizes required by the pertinent Regulations (e.g. R148, R150).

requirements.text: Each lamp submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
requirements.test_case: Verify by test report that the rear position, stop and reversing lamps meet all requirements of paragraphs 4 and 5.

requirements.text: The requirements contained in sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections) of UN Regulation No. 48 and its series of amendments in force at the time of application for the lamp type approval shall apply, the requirements pertinent to each lamp and to the M1 vehicle category being applied where their verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.
requirements.test_case: Check the lamp against the R48 sections 5 and 6 provisions for rear position, stop and reversing lamps on M1 vehicles that are verifiable at lamp approval (e.g. geometric visibility, apparent surface).

requirements.text: The lamps must be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, their satisfactory operation remains assured and they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Perform vibration/durability testing and confirm photometric and colorimetric characteristics are retained afterwards.

requirements.text: In the case of a rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp, these functions shall either be provided by multiple light sources (for instance, a double filament light source), or be intended for use in a vehicle equipped with a tell-tale indicating failure for the lamps.
requirements.test_case: Review the circuit design to confirm multiple light sources provide the functions, or that the lamp is declared for vehicles with a failure tell-tale.

requirements.text: The stop lamps and reversing lamps shall not incorporate a logo.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the stop and reversing lamp apparent surfaces and confirm no logo is incorporated in their optics or lens texture.

requirements.text: If the internal structure of the optical components and/or the texture of the outer lens inside the apparent surface of the rear position lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo, only one logo shall be incorporated and all requirements for the specific function of this Regulation shall be fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for the number of logos and verify photometry and colour of the function with the logo meet the requirements.

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp incorporates a logo, irrespective of the marking requirements in paragraph 3.3., only the logo of the brand name of the vehicle manufacturer or the body manufacturer is allowed, as confirmed by the applicant by a statement.
requirements.test_case: Check the logo is the vehicle or body manufacturer's brand logo and that the applicant's statement exists.

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp incorporates a logo, the enclosed light emitting surface of the logo (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 100 cm2.
requirements.test_case: Measure the projected enclosed logo surface in the reference axis direction and confirm it is ≤ 100 cm2.

requirements.text: In a single lamp containing more than one light source, a group of light sources, wired so that the failure of any one of them causes all of them to stop emitting light, shall be considered to be one light source.
requirements.test_case: Review the LED wiring diagram of each function to identify the light-source groups considered as one light source for failure assessment.

requirements.text: In case of failure of any one light source in a single rear position lamp or stop lamp containing more than one light source, at least one of the following provisions shall apply: (a) the light intensity complies with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution as shown in Annex 3 and when all light sources are illuminated the maximum intensities shall not be exceeded; or (b) a signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure, as indicated in paragraphs 6.7.8. and 6.11.8. etc. of UN Regulation No. 48, is produced, in which case a note in the communication form states that the lamp is only for use on a vehicle fitted with a tell-tale indicating failure.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of each light source (group) and measure intensities against Annex 3 minima with maxima met when all are lit, or verify a failure tell-tale signal is produced.

requirements.text: In case of failure of any one light source in a single reversing lamp containing more than one light source, the light intensity shall comply with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution as shown in Annex 3 and when all light sources are illuminated the maximum intensities shall not be exceeded, or a signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure shall be produced.
requirements.test_case: Simulate single light-source failure in the reversing lamp and check intensities remain above Annex 3 minima, or a failure signal is produced.

requirements.text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a rear position lamp category R2 emitting more than the maximum value of category R1, requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of the variable intensity control and verify the lamp automatically reverts to steady intensity within R1 limits.

requirements.text: The lamp shall only be equipped with replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128, provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval, and/or light source module(s) and/or non-replaceable light source(s).
requirements.test_case: Review the BOM and design to confirm the LEDs are non-replaceable light sources, light source modules or R37/R99/R128 approved replaceable light sources.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the design of the lamp shall be such that the light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to insert the light source in incorrect orientations and confirm only the correct position is possible.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the light source(s) holder shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061, applying the holder data sheet relevant to the category of light source(s) prescribed and, where a category of LED substitute light source(s) is also prescribed, the holder data sheet relevant to that category.
requirements.test_case: Gauge the holder against the relevant IEC 60061 data sheet(s).

requirements.text: Light Signalling Devices shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances, which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Perform EMC emission testing (e.g. per UN R10) and confirm no disturbances causing malfunction of other vehicle systems.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position and can only be removed with the use of tool(s).
requirements.test_case: Attempt incorrect fitting and tool-less removal of the module; both shall be impossible.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it is tamperproof.
requirements.test_case: Inspect module construction to confirm it cannot be opened or altered without destruction.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), regardless of the use of tool(s), the light source module shall not be interchangeable with any replaceable UN approved light source and/or any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to interchange the module with approved light sources and with other modules in the same housing; fitting shall be impossible.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of the device shall be met.
requirements.test_case: Replace the module with another of the same identification code and repeat photometric measurements; results shall comply.

requirements.text: All photometric and colorimetric measurements shall be made with respect to the conditions of paragraph 4.8., with the particulars of the methods of measurement given in Annex 3.
requirements.test_case: Review test report to confirm photometric and colorimetric measurements followed paragraph 4.8 conditions and Annex 3 methods.

requirements.text: For a lamp equipped with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), all measurements shall be made with the light source(s) present in the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Review the test report and confirm that the photometric measurements were made with the LED sources fitted in the lamp.

requirements.text: During photometric measurements, stray reflections shall be avoided by appropriate masking.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the photometric set-up and confirm that masking is in place to prevent stray reflections.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensities shall be measured with the light source continuously lit.
requirements.test_case: Verify that the rear position, stop and reversing lamps were measured with steady (continuous) operation.

requirements.text: The limits of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of each light-signalling lamp shall be determined.
requirements.test_case: Confirm that the apparent surface limits along the reference axis are documented for the position, stop and reversing lamps.

requirements.text: Unless otherwise specified, the voltage supplied at the lamp for testing shall be either 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems).
requirements.test_case: Measure the supply voltage at the lamp terminals during testing and confirm 13.5 V (12 V system) or 28 V (24 V system).

requirements.text: For a lamp controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Confirm that the test operating conditions match the applicant's declared control gear settings.

requirements.text: For a lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control and with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Confirm that the lamp was operated under the applicant-declared conditions during the test.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, on the reference axis (HV), be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Measure the HV intensity of both samples for each function and confirm it is at least the paragraph 5 minimum.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, in no direction where the lamp is visible, exceed the maximum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Scan the full visible field of both samples and confirm that no intensity exceeds the paragraph 5 maximum.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, outside the reference axis, be not less than the product of the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5 by the percentage specified in the pertinent light distribution figure in Annex 3 for each direction in question, or not less than the intensity value specified in the pertinent light distribution figure in Annex 3.
requirements.test_case: Measure every Annex 3 grid point and confirm it is at least the minimum × percentage, or the stated value.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, within the angles of geometric visibility defined in the tables in Annex 2, be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Measure across the Annex 2 geometric visibility angles and confirm the minimum intensity is met.

requirements.text: The provisions of the relevant paragraphs of Annex 3 on local variations of intensity shall be observed.
requirements.test_case: Evaluate the distribution against the Annex 3 local-variation rules.

requirements.text: If a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp producing either steady or variable luminous intensity, the ratio between the luminous intensities measured of the two lamps turned on simultaneously and the intensity of the rear position lamp turned on alone should be at least 5:1 in the field delimited by ±5° V and ±10° H of the light distribution table.
requirements.test_case: Measure the combined stop+position intensity against the position-only intensity at grid points within ±5° V / ±10° H and confirm a ratio of at least 5:1.

requirements.text: Tests for compliance of the luminous intensities shall be carried out according to Annex 8.
requirements.test_case: Confirm that the photometric test procedure follows Annex 8.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted shall be measured inside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function in the relevant paragraph of Annex 3.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity within the Annex 3 grid field of the red and white functions.

requirements.text: Outside the field of the light distribution grid, no sharp variation of colour shall be observed.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the colour visually or by measurement outside the grid and confirm there is no abrupt colour change.

requirements.text: To check the colorimetric characteristics, the test procedure described in paragraph 4.8. shall be applied.
requirements.test_case: Verify that the colorimetric test conditions (voltage, operation) match paragraph 4.8.

requirements.text: For lamps equipped with non-replaceable light sources, the colorimetric characteristics should be verified with the light sources present in the lamp, in accordance with relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 4.8.
requirements.test_case: Confirm that the colour measurement was done with the LEDs fitted in the lamp.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of rear position lamp supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 4.
requirements.test_case: Measure both rear position lamp samples and compare them with Table 4.

requirements.text: For rear position lamps of category R1 (steady), the minimum luminous intensity shall be 4 cd and the maximum luminous intensity shall be 17 cd when used as a single lamp, with the standard light distribution per Figure A3-I.
requirements.test_case: Measure HV ≥ 4 cd, max ≤ 17 cd, and the Figure A3-I grid values.

requirements.text: For rear position lamps of category R2 (variable), the minimum luminous intensity shall be 4 cd and the maximum luminous intensity shall be 42 cd when used as a single lamp (21 cd for a lamp marked "D"), with the standard light distribution per Figure A3-I.
requirements.test_case: Measure HV ≥ 4 cd and max ≤ 42 cd (≤ 21 cd if marked D) across the variable intensity range.

requirements.text: For rear position lamps reciprocally incorporated with stop lamps, a luminous intensity of 60 cd shall be permitted below a plane forming an angle of 5° with and downward from the horizontal plane.
requirements.test_case: Confirm that the intensity below 5° down is ≤ 60 cd and that the Table 4 maximum is met elsewhere.

requirements.text: Within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-1, the rear position lamp shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 0.05 cd as specified in Table 4.
requirements.test_case: Measure across the Table A2-1 angles and confirm ≥ 0.05 cd.

requirements.text: The colour of light emitted by the rear position lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity coordinates and confirm they lie within the red colour boundaries.

requirements.text: For a stop lamp of category S1 (steady), the minimum luminous intensity shall be 6.0∙10^1 cd, the maximum luminous intensity shall be 2.60∙10^2 cd when used as a single lamp or 1.30∙10^2 cd when used as a lamp marked "D", the standard light distribution shall be as defined in Figure A3-I, and within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-1 the minimum luminous intensity shall be 3∙10^-1 cd, as given in Table 7.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity on reference axis, at Figure A3-I grid points and across Table A2-1 angles; values within 60-260 cd (130 cd if 'D') and ≥0.3 cd in geometric visibility field.
