requirements.text: For a stop lamp of category S2 (variable), the minimum luminous intensity shall be 6.0∙10^1 cd, the maximum luminous intensity shall be 7.30∙10^2 cd when used as a single lamp or 3.65∙10^2 cd when used as a lamp marked "D", the standard light distribution shall be as defined in Figure A3-I, and within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-1 the minimum luminous intensity shall be 3∙10^-1 cd (day) and 7∙10^-2 cd (night), as given in Table 7.
requirements.test_case: Measure in day and night modes; intensities within 60-730 cd (365 cd if 'D') and ≥0.3 cd day / 0.07 cd night within Table A2-1 angles.

requirements.text: The minimum luminous intensity of the stop lamp within the angles of geometric visibility shall be as specified in Table 7.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity across the Table A2-1 angular field; values not below the Table 7 minimum for the category.

requirements.text: The stop lamp shall comply with the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6.
requirements.test_case: Simulate light source failure per paragraph 4.6 and verify the specified behaviour.

requirements.text: For a reversing lamp of category AR, the minimum luminous intensity shall be 8.0∙10^1 cd, as given in Table 10.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity on the reference axis; value ≥80 cd.

requirements.text: For a reversing lamp of category AR, the maximum luminous intensity in or above the H-plane shall be 3.00∙10^2 cd, as given in Table 10.
requirements.test_case: Scan intensity in and above the H-plane; no value exceeds 300 cd.

requirements.text: For a reversing lamp of category AR, the maximum luminous intensity below the H-plane, down to 5°D, shall be 6.00∙10^2 cd, as given in Table 10.
requirements.test_case: Scan intensity between H-plane and 5°D; no value exceeds 600 cd.

requirements.text: For a reversing lamp of category AR, the standard light distribution shall be as defined in Figure A3-V, as given in Table 10.
requirements.test_case: Measure at Figure A3-V grid points; values meet the required percentages of the minimum.

requirements.text: In the case where the reversing lamp is intended to be installed on a vehicle exclusively in a pair of devices and the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 30° inwards, a photometric value of at least 2.5∙10^1 cd shall be satisfied.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity at 30° inwards; value ≥25 cd.

requirements.text: The colour of light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of reversing lamp light through the lens; chromaticity within the white boundaries.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp (R1, R2) shall have minimum horizontal angles of geometric visibility of 45° inboard / 80° outboard, as given in Table A2-1 (angles shown are for lamps mounted on the right side of the vehicle).
requirements.test_case: Goniometric check of the rear position lamp confirms visibility of the apparent surface over at least 45° inboard and 80° outboard.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp (R1, R2) shall have minimum vertical angles of geometric visibility of 15° above / 15° below the H-plane, as given in Table A2-1.
requirements.test_case: Goniometric check confirms rear position lamp visibility at least 15° above and 15° below the H-plane.

requirements.text: For a rear position lamp (R1, R2) mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm, the reduced minimum horizontal angles of 20° inboard / 80° outboard may be used only below the H-plane.
requirements.test_case: Check that below the H-plane the rear position lamp is visible at least 20° inboard and 80° outboard, and full 45°/80° above the H-plane.

requirements.text: For a rear position lamp (R1, R2) to be installed with the H-plane at a mounting height of less than 750 mm, the minimum vertical angles of geometric visibility shall be 15° above / 5° below.
requirements.test_case: Goniometric check confirms rear position lamp visibility at least 15° above and 5° below the H-plane.

requirements.text: Unless specified otherwise, the values shown in Figures A3-I to A3-XV give, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required, which shall be mathematically rounded down to three significant digits.
requirements.test_case: Compute the required minimum at each grid point as the percentage of the required minimum, rounded down to three significant digits, and verify measured intensities meet it.

requirements.text: Where the rear position lamps are intended to be installed at a mounting height (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer) equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground, the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: If the declared mounting height is ≤ 750 mm, verify rear position lamp photometry down to 5° below horizontal only and confirm compliance there.

requirements.text: Where the stop lamps of category S1, S2 or MS are intended to be installed at a mounting height (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer) equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground, the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: If the declared mounting height is ≤ 750 mm, verify S1/S2 stop lamp photometry down to 5° below horizontal only and confirm compliance there.

requirements.text: Within the field of light distribution schematically shown as a grid, the light intensity in each direction of a part of the field formed by the grid lines shall meet at least the lowest minimum value being shown on the grid lines surrounding the questioned direction as a percentage.
requirements.test_case: Scan intensities between grid points for the rear position and stop lamps and verify each is at least the lowest surrounding grid minimum.

requirements.text: In the case of reversing lamps, if visual examination of a lamp appears to reveal substantial local variations of intensity, a check shall be made to ensure that no intensity measured between two of the directions of measurement is below 50 per cent of the lower minimum intensity of the two prescribed for these directions of measurement.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the reversing lamp; if local variations appear, measure between measuring directions and verify no value is below 50 % of the lower of the two adjacent minima.

requirements.text: The rear position lamps shall meet, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (see Tables 3, 4, 5, 7 and 8) given by the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement of the rear position lamp at the Figure A3-I points; each value shall be at least the stated percentage of the required minimum.

requirements.text: The stop lamps of category S1, S2 or MS shall meet, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (see Table 7) given by the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement of the stop lamp at the Figure A3-I points; each value shall be at least the stated percentage of the Table 7 minimum.

requirements.text: The reversing lamps shall meet, at the measuring points expressed in degrees of angle with the axis of reference, the minimum intensities in cd of the light emitted given in Figure A3-V.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement of the reversing lamp at the Figure A3-V points; each value shall be at least the stated cd value.

requirements.text: For reversing lamps using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after 1 minute and after 10 minutes of operation shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.test_case: Measure the reversing lamp intensities after 1 min and 10 min of operation, or calculate them via the HV ratio; all values must be within the min/max limits.

requirements.text: For rear position lamps using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either after 30 minutes of operation or after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.test_case: Measure the rear position lamp intensities after 1 min and after 30 min or at photometric stability; all values must be within the min/max limits.

requirements.text: Depending on the light source technology, the luminous intensity distribution of the rear position lamp is, in addition to paragraph 1, checked for compliance at 4 seconds after switch ON, with HV as the reference coordinate, as listed in Table A8-1.
requirements.test_case: Check the rear position lamp intensity distribution at 4 s after switch ON (scaled by the HV ratio); it must meet the min/max limits.

requirements.text: In case a lamp (function) uses LED technology only, the lamp (function) is deemed to comply with the corresponding intensity requirements at all points in time, if the values measured according to paragraph 1.2. are compliant.
requirements.test_case: Confirm that each function uses LEDs only and that the paragraph 1.2 measurements comply; compliance at all points in time is then deemed.

requirements.text: A separate approval is required for the retro-reflector (Class IA or IB) as a retro-reflective device listed in paragraph 1.
requirements.test_case: Check that a separate UN R150 approval exists for the retro-reflector of the rear lamp.

requirements.text: The approval number assigned to the approved type of retro-reflector shall be marked on the device following the requirements of paragraph 3.3.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the retro-reflector sample for the approval number marked per paragraph 3.3.

requirements.text: The symbol identifying the retro-reflector shall be "IA" for a retro-reflector for motor vehicles (independent) or "IB" for a retro-reflector for motor vehicles combined with other signal lamps which are not watertight, with a minimum "a" of 5 mm, as given in Table 1.
requirements.test_case: Verify the class symbol on the marking matches the class of the retro-reflector (IA or IB) and the lamp watertightness.

requirements.text: Every retro-reflector belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2., or for the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the drawings and sample for a marking space large enough for the approval marking/UI and other markings.

requirements.text: All markings on the retro-reflector shall be clearly legible and indelible.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect markings for legibility and perform a rub test to confirm indelibility.

requirements.text: With regard to the size of the approval marking, the value for "a" shall be as defined in Table 1 (minimum 5 mm for Class IA and IB retro-reflectors).
requirements.test_case: Measure the approval mark dimension "a" and confirm it is at least 5 mm.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking for a circle surrounding "E" and the country distinguishing number.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2., placed close to the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking for a 4-6 digit sequential number located close to the approval mark.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the symbols identifying the retro-reflective device prescribed in paragraph 3.2.5.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking for the class symbol IA or IB per Table 1.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the number of this Regulation followed by the letter "R" and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking for "150R" followed by the two-digit series of amendments.

requirements.text: If the approval marking is replaced by the Unique Identifier, the Unique Identifier mark shall follow the format in the example shown in Figure I.
requirements.test_case: If UI is used, compare the marking format against Figure I.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the sample for the applicant's trade name or mark.

requirements.text: In case of a retro-reflector of Class IA or IB, the retro-reflector shall bear the word "TOP" inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface, if such an indication is necessary to determine without ambiguity the angle or angles of rotation prescribed by the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Check whether the retro-reflector is rotation-sensitive and, if so, that "TOP" is inscribed horizontally at the highest part of the illuminating surface.

requirements.text: The approval marking or the Unique Identifier and the markings in paragraph 3.3.4. shall be clearly legible on the retro-reflector.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the retro-reflector to confirm all markings are clearly legible.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or Unique Identifier is affixed to the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, this marking shall be visible after their installation.
requirements.test_case: With the lamp installed on the vehicle, verify the single approval mark is visible.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark is affixed to the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, no part of the lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or the Unique Identifier.
requirements.test_case: Inspect construction to confirm that no light-transmitting part can be removed without removing the single approval mark.

requirements.text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
requirements.test_case: Measure the components of the single approval mark and compare against the smallest minimum size of the pertinent regulations.

requirements.text: The requirements contained in sections 5. "General specifications" and 6. "Individual specifications" and in the Annexes referenced in those sections of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the retro-reflecting device type approval, shall apply to the retro-reflector; the requirements pertinent to the retro-reflector and to the vehicle category (M1) on which it is intended to be installed shall be applied where their verification at the moment of type approval is feasible.
requirements.test_case: Review the retro-reflector against the applicable R48 sections 5 and 6 provisions verifiable at type approval; all feasible checks must pass.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall be so constructed that it functions satisfactorily and will continue to do so in normal use.
requirements.test_case: Inspect design and the results of the Annex 6/7 durability tests; the retro-reflector must keep functioning as specified.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to its efficient operation or to its maintenance in good condition.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect samples; no design or manufacturing defects affecting operation or maintenance may be found.

requirements.text: The components of the retro-reflector or parts thereof shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to dismantle the retro-reflector by hand without tools; the components must not separate easily.

requirements.text: The outer surface of the retro-reflector shall be easy to clean.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the outer surface; it must permit easy cleaning.

requirements.text: The outer surface of the retro-reflector shall not be rough and any protuberances the outer surface may exhibit shall not prevent easy cleaning.
requirements.test_case: Visually and tactilely inspect the outer surface; no roughness and no protuberances hindering cleaning.

requirements.text: There shall be no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflector when in normal use.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the assembled lamp; the inner surface of the retro-reflector must not be accessible in normal use.

requirements.text: If the retro-reflector consists of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter, the optical unit and filter shall be so designed that they cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the construction; optical unit and filter must not be separable under normal conditions of use.

requirements.text: The colouring of the retro-reflecting optical units and filters by means of paint or varnish is not permitted.
requirements.test_case: Check material/BOM and inspect samples; colour must be achieved without paint or varnish (e.g. tinted PMMA).

requirements.text: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity of the retro-reflector shall be within the limits for the night-time colour of the light retro-reflected from that device, as defined in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity x,y of the reflected light; values must lie within the R48 red night-time colour boundaries.

requirements.text: For testing the colour of the retro-reflector, the device shall be illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° or, if this produces a colourless surface reflection, an angle as specified in Annex 4, Part 1, paragraph 1.1.
requirements.test_case: Perform colorimetric measurement under Illuminant A at 1/3° divergence and β1=β2=0° (or Annex 4 angle) and record the conditions.

requirements.text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB shall meet the dimensions and shape requirements set forth in Annex 5.
requirements.test_case: Measure the retro-reflector shape and dimensions; they must comply with Annex 5 (e.g. non-triangular shape).

requirements.text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB shall meet the photometric and colorimetric requirements as specified in paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.
requirements.test_case: Perform photometric and colorimetric measurements; results must meet paragraphs 5.1.4 and 5.1.5.

requirements.text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB shall meet the physical and mechanical requirements set forth in paragraph 5.1.7., depending on the nature of the materials and construction of the retro-reflective devices.
requirements.test_case: Run the physical and mechanical tests of paragraph 5.1.7; all must be passed.

requirements.text: After verification of the general specifications (paragraph 4.) and the specifications of shape and dimensions (Annex 5), the ten samples of the retro-reflector shall be subjected to the heat resistance test described in Part 1 of Annex 6 and at least one hour after this test examined as to their colorimetric characteristics in paragraph 5.1.5. and RI in paragraph 5.1.4., for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° or if necessary in the position defined in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
requirements.test_case: Perform the Annex 6 Part 1 heat test on ten samples, then after ≥1 h measure colour and RI at 20', 0°/0°; values must comply.

requirements.text: The two retro-reflectors giving the minimum and maximum values after the heat resistance test shall be fully tested as shown in paragraph 5.1.4.
requirements.test_case: Fully measure RI at all Table 3 angles on the min and max samples; all values must meet paragraph 5.1.4.

requirements.text: The first group of two retro-reflector samples shall be subjected successively to the water penetration test (Part 2 of Annex 6) and then, if this test is satisfactory, to the tests for resistance to fuels and lubricants (Parts 1 and 2 of Annex 7).
requirements.test_case: Perform the water penetration test followed by the fuel and lubricant resistance tests; samples must pass.

requirements.text: The second group of two retro-reflector samples shall, if necessary, be subjected to the corrosion test in Part 4 of Annex 6, and then to the abrasive-strength test of the rear face of the retro-reflective device in Part 5 of Annex 6.
requirements.test_case: Perform the corrosion test (if applicable) and the rear-face abrasion test; samples must pass.

requirements.text: The third group of two retro-reflector samples shall be subjected to the test for stability in time of the optical properties of retro-reflective device in Part 3 of Annex 4.
requirements.test_case: Perform the Annex 4 Part 3 stability test; samples must retain compliant optical properties.

requirements.text: The fourth group of two retro-reflector samples shall be subjected to the resistance to weathering test (Part 6 of Annex 6).
requirements.test_case: Perform the Annex 6 Part 6 weathering test; samples must pass.

requirements.text: After undergoing the tests referred to in paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group shall have a colour which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.5.
requirements.test_case: Measure colour after each test group; chromaticity must satisfy paragraph 5.1.5.

requirements.text: After undergoing the tests referred to in paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group shall have a RI which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.4., verified only for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° or, if necessary, in all positions specified in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
requirements.test_case: Measure RI at 20', β1=β2=0° after each test group; values must meet paragraph 5.1.4.

requirements.text: For photometric measurements, only the illuminating surface defined by the planes contiguous to the outermost parts of the optical system of the retro-reflector as indicated by the manufacturer and contained within a circle of 200 mm diameter for Class IA or IB shall be considered, and the illuminating surface itself shall be limited to 100 cm2.
requirements.test_case: Check the illuminating surface used for measurement lies within a 200 mm diameter circle and does not exceed 100 cm2.

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values for red retro-reflectors of Class IA and IB shall be equal to or greater than those in Table 3, expressed in millicandelas per lux, for the angles of divergence and illumination shown.
requirements.test_case: Measure RI per Annex 4 Part 1 paragraph 3 at all Table 3 angles; all values ≥ Table 3 minima.

requirements.text: For a red retro-reflector of Class IA or IB, at an angle of divergence of 20', the RI shall be at least 300 mcd/lx at β1 = 0°, β2 = 0°; 200 mcd/lx at β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°; and 100 mcd/lx at β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°.
requirements.test_case: Measure RI at 20' divergence at the three illumination angle sets; values must be ≥300, ≥200 and ≥100 mcd/lx respectively.

requirements.text: RI values of the retro-reflector lower than those shown in the last two columns of Table 3 are not permissible within the solid angle having the centre of reference as its apex and bounded by the planes intersecting along the lines (β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°) and (β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°).
requirements.test_case: Scan RI within the defined solid angle; no value may fall below the relevant Table 3 minima.

requirements.text: Where the retro-reflector of Class IA or Class IB is intended to be installed with its H plane at a mounting height less than 750 mm above the ground, the RI values shall be verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: Confirm mounting height; if <750 mm, verify RI downward angles only to 5° and check compliance.

requirements.text: The testing of the colour of the retro-reflector (night-time colour) shall be carried out according to the method described in paragraph 4.2.1.
requirements.test_case: Verify the colour test report uses the paragraph 4.2.1 method (Illuminant A, 1/3°, 0°/0°).

requirements.text: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous flux of the retro-reflector shall be within the limits for the night-time colour red as specified in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity of reflected light; x,y must be within the R48 red night-time limits.

requirements.text: The retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB shall be subjected to the tests in the chronological order given in Table 4 (Chronological order of tests, Classes IA, IB, IIIA and IIIB).
requirements.test_case: Review the test report and confirm the samples were tested in the Table 4 sequence.

requirements.text: For retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB, the samples shall be subjected to the heat test of Part 1 of Annex 6 (48 h at 65 °C ± 2 °C), followed by a visual inspection for distortion.
requirements.test_case: Expose the samples for 48 h at 65 ± 2 °C, then inspect them; no distortion shall be visible.

requirements.text: When the RI of the retro-reflective device is measured for an angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, it shall be ascertained whether any mirror effect is produced by slightly turning the device.
requirements.test_case: During goniophotometric measurement at β1 = β2 = 0°, turn the retro-reflector slightly and check for a mirror effect.

requirements.text: If any mirror effect is produced, a reading of the RI of the retro-reflective device shall be taken with an angle β of β1 = -5°, β2 = 0°.
requirements.test_case: If a mirror effect is observed, measure RI at β1 = -5°, β2 = 0° and use that reading.

requirements.text: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', retro-reflective devices which are not marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes of reference to the position of minimum RI, which must conform to the value specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Rotate the unmarked retro-reflector about its reference axis at β = 0°, α = 20' and verify the minimum RI meets the paragraph 5 value.

requirements.text: For retro-reflective devices not marked "TOP", when the RI is measured for the other angles of illumination and divergence, the retro-reflective device shall be placed in the position corresponding to this value of ε (minimum RI), and if the specified values are not attained, the device may be rotated about its axis of reference only within ±5° from that position.
requirements.test_case: Measure RI at all other illumination/divergence angles at the minimum-RI ε position (±5° allowed) and verify specified values are met.

requirements.text: For retro-reflective devices marked "TOP", the RI must not fall below the prescribed value in any position assumed by the device during the ±5° rotation.
requirements.test_case: Record RI throughout the ±5° rotation and verify no value is below the prescribed minimum.

requirements.text: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 4. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', retro-reflective devices marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes ±5°.
requirements.test_case: Rotate the TOP-marked retro-reflector ±5° about its axis at β = 0°, α = 20' while measuring RI.

requirements.text: If for the direction β1 = β2 = 0°, and for ε = 0° the RI exceeds the specified value by 50 per cent or more, all measurements for all angles of illumination and divergence shall be made for ε = 0°.
requirements.test_case: If RI at β = 0°, ε = 0° is ≥150 % of the specified value, perform all measurements at ε = 0° and verify compliance.

requirements.text: For testing the retro-reflection the retro-reflective devices shall be illuminated with a CIE Standard Illuminant A (ISO 11664-2:2007(E)/CIE S 014-2/E:2006) and measured as described in Part 1 of Annex 4.
requirements.test_case: Verify the test source is CIE Standard Illuminant A and the procedure follows Annex 4 Part 1.

requirements.text: For retro-reflective devices of Class IA or IB, the shape of the illuminating surfaces shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape, as prescribed for retro-reflectors mentioned in paragraph 2.1., from an observation distance of 10 metres.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the retro-reflector illuminating surface from 10 m and confirm its shape cannot easily be confused with the equilateral triangle of Class IIIA/IIIB.

requirements.text: For moulded plastics reflectors of retro-reflecting devices of Classes IA and IB, the retro-reflective device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C, after which the sample shall be allowed to cool for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 °C.
requirements.test_case: Condition the retro-reflector 48 h at 65 °C ± 2 °C dry, then cool 1 h at 23 °C ± 2 °C, and record the conditioning log.

requirements.text: After the resistance to heat test, no cracking or appreciable distortion of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of its optical component must be visible.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the retro-reflector after heat conditioning; pass if no cracking or appreciable distortion, especially of the optical component.

requirements.text: For the water penetration test, the retro-reflective device, whether part of a lamp or not, shall be stripped of all removable parts and immersed for 10 minutes in water at a temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C, the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface being 20 mm below the surface of the water.
requirements.test_case: Strip removable parts and immerse the device 10 min in water at 50 °C ± 5 °C with the top of the illuminating surface 20 mm below the water surface.

requirements.text: The water immersion test shall be repeated after turning the retro-reflective device through 180°, so that the illuminating surface is at the bottom and the rear face is covered by about 20 mm of water.
requirements.test_case: Repeat the 50 °C immersion with the device inverted, rear face under about 20 mm of water.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device sample units shall then be immediately immersed in the same conditions in water at a temperature of 25 °C ± 5 °C.
requirements.test_case: Immediately after the 50 °C immersions, immerse the device under the same conditions in water at 25 °C ± 5 °C.

requirements.text: After the water penetration test, no water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit; if visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the device shall not be considered to have passed the test.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the reflecting surface after immersion; fail if water is clearly present.

requirements.text: If visual inspection does not reveal the presence of water or in case of doubt, the RI of the retro-reflector shall be measured by the method described in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, the retro-reflective device being first lightly shaken to remove excess water from the outside.
requirements.test_case: After lightly shaking off external water, measure the RI per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. and check compliance with the required values.

requirements.text: As an alternative, at the request of the manufacturer, the moisture and dust tests of Annex 6 Part 3 shall be applied to the Class IB retro-reflective device.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report shows the moisture and dust tests of Annex 6 Part 3 were applied when the manufacturer chose this alternative.

requirements.text: Since the retro-reflector is reciprocally incorporated or grouped with signalling or lighting functions, these functions shall be operated at design voltage during the water spray test according to a cycle of 5 min ON (in flashing mode, where appropriate), 55 min OFF.
requirements.test_case: Check the test log shows the rear position, stop and reversing functions were cycled 5 min ON / 55 min OFF at design voltage.

requirements.text: Upon completion of the drain period, no standing pool of water shall be allowed to be formed in the device, or which can be formed by tapping or tilting the device.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the interior, then tap and tilt the device; pass if no standing pool of water is present or forms.

requirements.text: Upon completion of the drain period, the RI shall be measured according to the method specified in Part 1 of Annex 4 after having dried the exterior of the device with a dry cotton cloth.
requirements.test_case: Dry the exterior with a dry cotton cloth and measure the RI per Annex 4 Part 1; compare it with the initial RI.

requirements.text: Upon completion of the dust exposure test, the exterior of the device shall be cleaned and dried with a dry cotton cloth and the RI measured according to the method specified in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Clean and dry the exterior, measure the RI per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. and evaluate it against the initial RI.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective devices shall be so designed that they retain the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which they are normally exposed.
requirements.test_case: Perform the corrosion test of Annex 6 Part 4 and verify the photometric and colorimetric values still meet the prescribed limits.

requirements.text: The resistance of the front surface of the retro-reflective device to tarnishing and of the protection of the rear face to deterioration shall be checked, particularly when an essential metal component seems liable to be attacked, according to ISO Standard 9227:2017.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the front surface and rear-face protection after the ISO 9227:2017 salt spray test; there must be no tarnishing or deterioration.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device, or the lamp if the device is combined with a light, shall be stripped of all removable parts and subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours, comprising two periods of exposure of 24 hours each, separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.
requirements.test_case: Check the test record shows the combination lamp, stripped of removable parts, was exposed to 2 x 24 h saline mist with a 2 h drying interval.

requirements.text: In the case of retro-reflective devices with essential metal components susceptible to corrosion, the saline mist shall be produced by atomizing, at a temperature of 35 °C ± 2 °C, a saline solution obtained by dissolving 5 parts by weight of sodium chloride in 95 parts of distilled water containing not more than 0.02 per cent of impurities.
requirements.test_case: Verify the salt spray chamber was run at 35 °C ± 2 °C with a 5 % NaCl solution in distilled water with ≤0.02 % impurities.

requirements.text: Immediately after completion of the corrosion test, the sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the sample immediately after the salt spray test; no corrosion impairing efficiency is allowed.

requirements.text: After the corrosion test, the coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas, when measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', shall be not less than the value in Table 9 or more than the value in Table 10 respectively.
requirements.test_case: After 48 h recovery, measure RA at β2 = 5°, α = 20' and compare against Table 9 minimum and Table 10 maximum.

requirements.text: For moulded plastics reflectors of Classes IA and IB with an accessible mirror-backed rear face, the reverse side of the retro-reflective device shall be brushed with a hard nylon brush.
requirements.test_case: Verify the test record shows the rear face was brushed with a hard nylon brush.

requirements.text: After having brushed the rear face, in the case of moulded plastics reflectors of Classes IA and IB, a cotton cloth soaked in the mixture defined in Part 1 of Annex 7 shall be applied to the said rear face for one minute, after which the cloth is removed and the retro-reflective device left to dry.
requirements.test_case: Apply a cotton cloth soaked in the Annex 7 Part 1 mixture to the rear face for 1 min, remove and let dry.

requirements.text: For mirror-backed retro-reflective devices with accessible rear face, the RI shall then be measured, according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, after the whole surface of the mirror-backed rear face has been covered with Indian ink.
requirements.test_case: Cover the rear face with Indian ink, measure RI per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. and check compliance with the required values.

requirements.text: When subjected to the resistance to weathering test, the retro-reflective device samples shall be exposed to accelerated artificial weathering in accordance with EN ISO 4892-2:2013 using the parameters given in Table A6-1.
requirements.test_case: Review the weathering test report to confirm exposure was carried out per EN ISO 4892-2:2013 with the Table A6-1 parameters.

requirements.text: In case of retro-reflective devices, the samples shall be exposed to accelerated artificial weathering in accordance with EN ISO 4892-2:2013 for a period of 500 hours.
requirements.test_case: Verify from the test log that the retro-reflector samples were exposed for 500 hours.

requirements.text: For the resistance to fuels test, a test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol shall be applied to the retro-reflective device.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the fuel resistance test used a 70/30 vol.% n-heptane/toluol mixture on the retro-reflector.

requirements.text: After about five minutes following the wiping with the test mixture, the surface of the retro-reflective device shall be inspected visually and must not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the surface about five minutes after wiping; pass if no apparent surface change other than slight surface cracks.

requirements.text: The outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in the test mixture of 70 vol. per cent n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent toluol.
requirements.test_case: Wipe the retro-reflector outer/illuminating surface with a cotton cloth soaked in the test mixture and record the procedure.

requirements.text: For moulded plastics reflectors of Classes IA and IB, after the lubricating oil exposure and cleaning, the RI of the retro-reflective device shall be measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure RI per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. after the oil test and verify the values meet the limits required by that paragraph.

requirements.text: For moulded plastics reflectors of Classes IA and IB, the outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a detergent lubricating oil.
requirements.test_case: Wipe the outer and illuminating surface with a cotton cloth soaked in detergent lubricating oil and record that the exposure was applied.

requirements.text: For moulded plastics reflectors of Classes IA and IB, after about 5 minutes of exposure to the detergent lubricating oil, the surface of the retro-reflective device shall be cleaned.
requirements.test_case: After about 5 minutes of oil exposure, clean the surface and confirm it is free of residue before measurement.

requirements.text: In the approval mark affixed to the retro-reflective device, the approval number must be placed close to, but in any position in relation to, the circle surrounding the letter "E".
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval mark on the retro-reflector and confirm the approval number is located close to the circle surrounding the letter E.

requirements.text: In the approval mark affixed to the retro-reflective device, the digits constituting the approval number must face the same way as the "E".
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval mark and confirm the approval number digits are oriented in the same direction as the letter E.

requirements.text: In the approval mark affixed to the retro-reflective device, the group of symbols indicating the class must be diametrically opposite the approval number.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval mark and confirm the class symbol (e.g. IA or IB) is placed diametrically opposite the approval number relative to the E circle.
